 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The pattern in one compartment is tiled into every compartment.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hs = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row)]
    vs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(h)]
    rb = [0] + [i + 1 for i in hs] + [h]
    cb = [0] + [j + 1 for j in vs] + [w]
    # Locate the non-background compartment and use it as the source tile.
    tiles = [(rb[r], rb[r+1], cb[c], cb[c+1]) for r in range(len(rb)-1) for c in range(len(cb)-1)]
    src = next(t for t in tiles if any(grid[i][j] != 9 for i in range(t[0], t[1]) for j in range(t[2], t[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = src
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,c,d in tiles:
        for i in range(b-a):
            for j in range(d-c):
                out[a+i][c+j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
"
}
